_comment: APEX ledger config. Copy to <PROJECT_ROOT>/.apex/config.json and fill in. Keys are camelCase and must match ApexConfig exactly — a key APEX does not recognise is reported, never silently ignored. schemaVersion marks the file's generation: migration adds it to an older file and adds nothing else. Personal defaults (memory policy, language, archive detail) live in the GLOBAL config at <APEX home>/config.json — this file is project truth only.
_verifyCommandsNote: Tier names are exactly these. There is no 'test' or 'run' tier — the whole-project check is 'suite', and executing the thing is 'runtime'.
_contextNote: Context budgets (44 §3). budgetTokens is the ceiling for the whole working context — attached content over 50% is refused, over 25% warns (54 §11.1). learnedContextTokens caps the memory+skills subtotal (32 §3). freezeHotSnapshot freezes global memory at session start; mid-session writes arrive through the corrections overlay (13 §3).
_skillsNote: Skills (44 §3, 54 §7/§8). maxBodiesPerTask caps skill bodies loaded per task; seedSkills ships the bundled seed library. projectSkills: repository-supplied SKILL.md files are DATA — 'off' (default) ignores them, 'readonly' lists them, 'trusted' needs your explicit hash-bound grant (never automatic). autoPromote:false means promotion always needs the evidence gate. maxIndexTokens caps the model-facing index.
_capabilitiesNote: Host-provided code intelligence (54 §14). APEX never installs language servers; hostDiagnostics lets a host that already exposes semantic diagnostics record them as evidence. diagnosticsMessage holds the latest host-reported message (evidence only). schemaBudgetTokens caps the compact capability index in tokens (44 §3/WP-053). discovery: 'auto' probes the host at start, 'manual' waits. lazySchemas: 'auto' defers heavy tool schemas (22 §2). aliasOverrides maps a host tool name to a canonical capability id — explicit only.
_delegationNote: See core/13-FLEET.md. mode: OFF | AUTO | DIRECTED_ONLY | AGGRESSIVE
_memoryNote: Durable memory (44 §3, 10). useGlobal:false stops global memory from being retrieved in THIS project (records are never deleted by it). globalCategories excludes one category (09 §7) — 'relationship' is off by default. writePolicy narrows what the autonomy mode allows ('stage' quarantine, 'off' nothing writes) — it can only restrict, never widen. mirror generates a block into an explicit target file (14 §5); includePersonal:false is a hard default — personal facts are never mirrored.
_archiveNote: Session archive (44 §3, 15/16). detail: 'off' | 'capsule' | 'compact' | 'full'. events.maxAgeDays / toolOutput.maxAgeDays feed retention (apex-agent session prune); pruning is explicit and never touches the verification ledger (16 §7).
_learningNote: Self-learning loop (44 §3, 17). extractOn names the lifecycle events that feed the extractor; candidateScope limits where new memory/skill candidates may be proposed ('project' default — the global store only via explicit user action).
